blind.description: An elegant classical or neoclassical backless bench featuring an elongated rectangular cushioned top upholstered in olive-green fabric with gold floral patterns. The seat rests on a cream/ivory painted wooden apron trimmed with gold molding, supported by six fluted tapered square legs with gold caps and block bases. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken parts, resting properly on its six feet.
blind.from_above: A rounded-corner rectangle of olive-green upholstery patterned with dispersed small gold floral sprigs, framed minimally at the corners by cream and gold leg tops.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third to one-fourth as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.5 ft high), and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft in length by 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
